internal_minimum_source: Pinned synthetic policy. Not a statute. SYSC 6.1.1R states no number of months.

extracts.title: Compliance arrangements
extracts.text: The firm must keep a register of the obligations that apply to its designated investment business and must review that register at least every 12 months.

extracts.title: Compliance arrangements
extracts.text: The firm must keep a register of the obligations that apply to its designated investment business and must review that register at least every 12 months, except where the activity is carried on only for the firm's own account.

extracts.title: Compliance arrangements
extracts.text: The firm must keep a register of the obligations that apply to its designated investment business.

extracts.title: Compliance arrangements
extracts.text: The firm must review that register of obligations every 24 months.

extracts.title: Compliance arrangements
extracts.text: It is not true that the firm must keep a register of obligations.

extracts.title: Synthetic certification rule
extracts.text: The firm must issue a certificate to an employee before that employee performs a specified function, unless the function lasts under a day.

extracts.title: Superseded certification rule
extracts.text: The firm must issue a certificate to an employee before that employee performs a specified function. This provision is not superseded.

extracts.title: Synthetic approval extract
extracts.text: The firm must take reasonable care to ensure that a controlled function is performed only in accordance with an approval recorded by the firm.

extracts.title: Future insurance extract
extracts.text: The firm must keep a register of the obligations that will apply to its insurance distribution from the date this extract comes into force.

extracts.title: Complaints log
extracts.text: The firm must record every complaint in the complaints log.
